characters.name: Monsieur St. Aubert
characters.description: Retired gentleman of Gascony; father of Emily, owner of La Vallée and its château.

characters.name: Madame St. Aubert
characters.description: Wife of Monsieur St. Aubert; deceased mother of Emily whose death precipitates later events.

characters.name: Emily
characters.description: Only surviving daughter of Monsieur and Madame St. Aubert; protagonist who is educated, sensitive and affectionate.

characters.name: Manchon
characters.description: Emily’s dog, faithful household animal at La Vallée.

characters.name: Theresa
characters.description: Old housekeeper of the St. Aubert household; devoted servant at La Vallée.

characters.name: Jacques
characters.description: Domestic servant dismissed by Monsieur St. Aubert before his journey.

characters.name: Francis
characters.description: Domestic servant dismissed by Monsieur St. Aubert.

characters.name: Mary
characters.description: Domestic servant dismissed by Monsieur St. Aubert.

characters.name: Michael
characters.description: Muleteer who drives St. Aubert and Emily on mountain roads.

characters.name: Monsieur Quesnel
characters.description: Mons. Quesnel, Madame St. Aubert’s brother; ambitious, worldly and instrumental in disposing of La Vallée.

characters.name: Madame Quesnel
characters.description: Wife of Monsieur Quesnel; a vain, Italian heiress by birth who appears in company at La Vallée.

characters.name: M. Motteville
characters.description: Agent/banker in Paris who holds some of St. Aubert’s property and whose affairs affect St. Aubert’s finances.

characters.name: M. Barreaux
characters.description: A retired gentleman, botanist and friend of St. Aubert who visits La Vallée and the travellers.

characters.name: La Voisin
characters.description: Old peasant (called La Voisin) who hospitably shelters Emily after her father’s death; owner of a cottage in the woods.

characters.name: Agnes
characters.description: Daughter of La Voisin; helps welcome Emily and her father at the cottage.

characters.name: Valancourt
characters.description: A young gentleman (Chevalier) from Gascony; Emily’s suitor and the principal romantic interest; ardent, generous and somewhat impulsive.

characters.name: Signor Montoni
characters.description: Italian gentleman who marries Madame Cheron and later becomes central to Emily’s misfortunes; proud, secretive and potentially dangerous.

characters.name: Signor Cavigni
characters.description: Friend of Montoni; an insinuating, agreeable Italian who flatters and amuses society.

characters.name: Madame Cheron
characters.description: Emily’s aunt (sister of Monsieur St. Aubert) and appointed guardian; worldly, vain and often unsympathetic.

characters.name: Count Morano
characters.description: A Venetian nobleman who presses an unwelcome suit to marry Emily; persistent and importunate.

characters.name: Signora Clairval
characters.description: Madame Clairval (a widow of rank) who entertains at Venice and is related to other characters; her circle influences local alliances.

characters.name: Signora Livona
characters.description: A fashionable Venetian lady introduced to Emily; admired for beauty and manner.

characters.name: Signora Herminia
characters.description: Venetian lady and musician who sings and charms Emily in society.

characters.name: Signora Laurentini
characters.description: A former lady of Udolpho (the castle) mentioned in local tradition as having mysteriously disappeared and been seen after death; figure of local legend.

characters.name: Signor Bertolini
characters.description: Member of Montoni’s acquaintance; part of the circle that frequents the Montoni household.

characters.name: Signor Orsino
characters.description: A reserved, haughty Italian associate of Montoni; later implicated in a violent incident and concealed by Montoni.

characters.name: Signor Verezzi
characters.description: A volatile, imaginative Italian companion of Montoni; lively and adventurous but fickle.

characters.name: Utaldo
characters.description: Captain Utaldo, a military leader whose passing army is observed by the travellers.

characters.name: Count Bauvillers
characters.description: A nobleman who attends company and comments on local fashions and people.

characters.name: Mademoiselle d’Emery
characters.description: A young woman of fortune mentioned in society gossip as a possible match for Valancourt.

characters.name: Carlo
characters.description: Old steward/servant of the Udolpho castle (referred to as the old man Carlo) who manages the house and reports its condition.

characters.name: Caterina
characters.description: Servant at Udolpho castle who assists Emily and Annette within the household.

characters.name: Annette
characters.description: Madame Montoni’s woman/maid who accompanies Emily, a talkative servant prone to superstitious tales.

characters.name: Benedetto
characters.description: A local gondolier/peasant mentioned in conversation and tales told to Annette.

characters.name: Ludovico
characters.description: A gondolier/lacquey figure mentioned by servants in relation to Venice and local regattas.

characters.name: Cesario
characters.description: Count Morano’s valet and attendant (servant mentioned in castle scenes)

characters.name: Barnardine
characters.description: The porter of Udolpho; implicated in late conspiracies and privy to castle secrets

characters.name: Launcelot
characters.description: Trumpeter among the castle soldiers/watch; referenced as musician on the ramparts

characters.name: Monsieur Du Pont
characters.description: Frenchman rescued from imprisonment at Udolpho; mistakenly believed by Emily’s household to be Valancourt at one point

characters.name: Dorothée
characters.description: Housekeeper at Château-le-Blanc (Count De Villefort’s estate); longtime servant who recalls the Marchioness

characters.name: Maddelina
characters.description: Daughter of the peasant couple who host Emily in Tuscany; modest and kind

characters.name: Count De Villefort
characters.description: Count who inherits Château-le-Blanc (successor of the Marquis De Villeroi); hospitable Languedoc noble

characters.name: Countess (De Villefort)
characters.description: Wife of Count De Villefort; elegant, capricious, and often discontented with rural life

characters.name: Henri
characters.description: Son of Count De Villefort; young man in the French service

characters.name: Blanche
characters.description: Daughter of Count De Villefort (often called Lady Blanche); youthful, innocent, delighted by Languedoc scenery

characters.name: Mademoiselle Bearn
characters.description: Friend and companion of the Countess De Villefort; accompanies her at Château-le-Blanc

characters.name: Marquis De Villeroi
characters.description: Former owner of Château-le-Blanc; deceased relative whose estate passed to Count De Villefort

characters.name: Friar (unnamed)
characters.description: A monk/friar from the neighbouring monastery who performed the funeral rites for Madame Montoni

characters.name: The Superior
characters.description: Superior of the neighbouring monastery (monastic official who interacts with Count De Villefort and travelers)

characters.name: The Lady Abbess
characters.description: Head of the convent of St. Claire; she receives Emily and her party hospitably at the monastery

characters.name: Father Pierre
characters.description: One of the fathers (priests) named in accounts about celestial music heard at night

characters.name: Father Antoine
characters.description: Another priest named alongside Father Pierre regarding reports of strange nocturnal music

characters.name: Annette
characters.description: Female servant in the Count’s household; talkative, superstitious and deeply affected by the castle’s rumours

characters.name: Baron de Saint Foix
characters.description: Older nobleman, friend of Count De Villefort; father of the Chevalier St. Foix

characters.name: Chevalier (Mons.) St. Foix
characters.description: Young man, son of the Baron de Saint Foix; admirer and later husband of Lady Blanche; wounded in an encounter with banditti

characters.name: Monsieur Bonnac
characters.description: Officer who appears at the convent; connected to Laurentini’s bequest and provides background on Valancourt’s aid to his family

characters.name: Sister Agnes
characters.description: Nun at the convent of St. Claire (formerly of gentle birth) who is tormented by remorse and madness and who dies; gives key dying statements

characters.name: Sister Frances
characters.description: Nun at St. Claire who relates convent news and Agnes’s background; conversant with convent affairs

characters.name: Mademoiselle Feydeau
characters.description: Boarder at the convent; inquisitive about local scandals and convent stories

characters.name: Jean the gardener
characters.description: Gardener at Thoulouse/La Vallée; encounters a stranger in the garden and fires, prompting concern for Valancourt

characters.name: Jacques
characters.description: One of the hunters/occupants of the ruined fortress encountered by the travellers in the Pyrenees

characters.name: Pierre
characters.description: Valet in the Count’s household who converses about the mysterious music and servants’ fears

characters.name: Gregoire
characters.description: Butler mentioned in accounts of household affairs at Estuvière; former servant reference

characters.name: Gabriel
characters.description: Servant in the Valancourt/Estuvière household quoted about Valancourt’s conduct and servants’ feelings

characters.name: Philip
characters.description: Butler/servant mentioned by Dorothée in an anecdote from the Marchioness’s time

characters.name: Richard
characters.description: Neighbour’s son and oboe player who performs by Theresa’s cottage; his music is noted in the narrative

characters.name: Marchioness de Villeroi
characters.description: Late Marchioness whose unhappy marriage and death are central backstory; related to Emily (St. Aubert’s sister)

characters.name: Sir Bevys of Lancaster
characters.description: Character in the Provençal tale Ludovico reads; English knight whose body and story are recounted in the tale

characters.name: Baron de Brunne
characters.description: Baron in the Provençal tale who entertains knights and minstrels; figure in Ludovico’s recited story
